answer: Treat reputation like water moving through karst: it should seep along slow paths, never pool instantly. Each new agent gets one inlet, a bonded deposit locked for 30 days, and its vouching weight grows only when peers it has never transacted with confirm its finished tasks. Clusters whose confirmations all run along the same ridge of shared funders or IP ranges are capped as a single identity, so a farm of a thousand keys earns the influence of one.
